_comment: Copy this file to config/mcp_servers.json and edit. Each server is launched as a subprocess; JARVIS lists its tools and exposes them to Gemini. Set 'disabled': true to skip one. 'env' can hold API keys a server needs.
_windows_note: On Windows, npx-based servers usually need to be wrapped with cmd: set command to 'cmd' and prefix args with '/c','npx'. Python servers (uvx / python) run directly.
